about_short_description.short_description: Vendo is a digital growth agency that specializes in Amazon and Walmart.com online marketplaces.

product.name: Marketplace Management
product.description: Management of product listings, inventory, and sales optimization on online marketplaces like Amazon and Walmart.com.

product.name: Media Buying
product.description: Planning and purchasing advertising space across retail media, programmatic, connected TV, paid search, and social platforms to reach target customers.

product.name: Marketing Planning & Strategy
product.description: Development and execution of marketing strategies including influencer and affiliate marketing, email and SMS campaigns, user-generated content, and experiential marketing.

product.name: Amazon DSP Strategy
product.description: Utilization of Amazon Demand-Side Platform for programmatic advertising to retarget and prospect customers on and off Amazon.

product.name: Branded Live Chat Customer Support
product.description: Implementation and management of branded live chat support on Amazon product pages to reduce returns and negative reviews.

product.name: Subscribe 'N Save Program Optimization
product.description: Strategies to increase customer enrollment and retention in Amazon's Subscribe 'N Save recurring delivery program.
